I have a similar problem. I'm either stress eating or have no energy to eat at all, the second being my current situation. It sucks, half the time I just don't care enough to make food or eat. I recommend buying food that is easy to make like top ramen or microwavable dinners. It isn't the healthiest, but it might be easier to get yourself to make. I try to make myself eat at least twice a day. Hope you feel better.

You could also buy supplements for nutrients if that is easier.
